feature_contract.goal: Prevent the original game's screen-edge stage sphere projection from corrupting culling bounds when the DX9Ex R84 source viewport is unavailable, zero-sized, nonfinite or overflows during Reset, VR resize and native 4:3/16:9/21:9/portrait transitions while keeping normal scene-edge visibility.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original screen-edge CalcBall3D2D sphere-correction hook and native C++ regression only; no world stereo matrix, stage-culling policy toggle, R84 shader owner, HUD, SkyGlow, FFB, input, R26_SAFE or DXVK change.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source-confirmed unchecked Game::screen_resolution dereference and division by zero/NaN followed by non-atomic writes to both original game culling sphere components; deterministic finite/invalid source cases are covered in a native compiled test.
trace_stages: Original CalcBall3D2D produces current stage-object screen-space culling sphere and float return
ScreenEdgeCullFix game hook maps both output components from actual source aspect to canonical native 4:3, accepting only fully finite results
Stage visibility consumes uncorrupted original or validated corrected sphere; R84 world eye draw and host OpenXR composition stay unchanged
subcomponents: Make viewport dependency and game-culling sphere correction atomic and fail-closed across zero/unpublished dimensions, NaN, Inf and arithmetic overflow.
Keep original numeric mapping bit-identical for all valid native, wide and portrait viewports and integrate compiled native positive/negative regression with the R84 source build.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Correct both original game sphere components at valid source sizes without changing old arithmetic or screen-edge object visibility.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex Reset, minimized viewport, malformed/corrupted culling bounds
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Invalid viewport or overflow never writes a partially mapped Sphere; game original value and CalcBall3D2D HRESULT-equivalent return are preserved.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Windows x86 active game, R26_SAFE rollback, host package and independent Domain isolation
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Full exact-SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain, Full Source/HUD as applicable and native game-host smoke gates pass without CI skip.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Game ScreenEdgeCullFix directly dereferenced Game::screen_resolution and divided by source height without checking valid Reset/VR resize transition values; it overwrote a3->f0 and a3->f1 independently before validating finite results.
source_trace: Original CalcBall3D2D_Addr=0x49E70 writes native 4:3 stage Cull sphere and returns original float.
ScreenEdgeCullFix::destination modifies the original game's a3->f0/f1 using source aspect after the original call, even if the source height is zero.
CorrectBallProjection stages finite pair then commits only on success, protecting the R84 draw submission input and preserving R26_SAFE and original stage-culling switch.
diagnosis.root_cause: Unconditional source resolution dereference and float division plus sequential unchecked writes can poison original game Cull sphere when viewport is absent or invalid.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally disable stage culling or widen VR FOV without a proven source camera/visibility mapping.
Do not modify the R84 renderer or reduce native DX9Ex quality; this specific defect occurs before game 3D draw and must preserve all correct old mappings.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Actual source CalcBall3D2D now takes a fully validated pure finite projection result and changes original sphere only if both corrected coordinates pass; portable native smoke adds valid and poisoned viewport cases.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Negative cases zero/negative height, NaN, Inf, sphere overflow and source aspect overflow reject without valid update. Tested missing <initializer_list> fails g++ -std=c++17 with required header diagnostic; host dependency now compiles corrected test in the existing mandatory Windows Gate.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This original game culling sphere feeds the shared source visibility before R84 projects world content separately for both eyes; this fix does not modify binocular c64 matrices or host projection.
diagnosis.compilation_regression: The newly declared stand-alone stage-edge smoke target revealed a missing standard <initializer_list> include in a native g++ C++17 compile; the original mandatory host target did not build the new smoke executable. The repair provides the header and makes exact-SHA host compilation depend on the game-side smoke.

next_action: C6 exact-SHA CI SUCCESS reported; physical Quest3/VDXR stage-edge object culling during Reset, resize, 4:3/16:9/21:9 and portrait remains UNTESTED. No automatic HMD PASS.
